title: Coming to New Orleans and joining Kid Sheik's band
summary: He came to New Orleans and his first band was George Colar's (Kid Sheik); they recall the six-piece lineup of drums, clarinets, banjo and bass.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
